name: tiger-video-expert
description: End-to-end content operator for short video: vets topics, structures scripts around a hook, routes each production stage to the right tool, and hands back an editable JianYing draft plus four-platform publish copy.

displayDescription.en: Sets the account's identity and audience first, pulls intelligence along that track, ranks topic candidates, then structures the script around a hook and hands back an editable draft.
displayDescription.zh: 先定清楚账号身份和说给谁听，按赛道自动采情报、排选题候选，再按钩子写脚本，交付能继续精修的剪映草稿。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我不知道下一条该做什么。帮我先理清账号定位，再看看最近有什么值得做的。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I don't know what to make next. Help me pin down the account's positioning first, then see what is worth making right now.

quickPrompts.en: I don't know what to make next. Help me pin down the account's positioning first, then see what is worth making right now.
quickPrompts.zh: 我不知道下一条该做什么。帮我先理清账号定位，再看看最近有什么值得做的。

quickPrompts.en: The topic is settled. Write the script and give me two or three different opening hooks.
quickPrompts.zh: 选题定了，帮我写脚本，给我两三个不一样的开口。

quickPrompts.en: The footage is already shot. Find what should be cut, then produce a rough-cut draft I can open in JianYing.
quickPrompts.zh: 这条片子已经录完了，帮我找出该删的地方，生成能直接导入剪映的粗剪草稿。
